items.description: Role metadata (author, description, platforms, dependencies)
Handlers for nginx reload, fail2ban restart, ssh restart triggered by config changes
Role argument specs for fail-fast parameter validation (generate after defaults/main.yml is written)
Chef attributes converted to Ansible defaults: nginx sites list, security SSH flags (disable_root, password_auth), SSL settings, sysctl parameters, fail2ban jail settings
Entry point: includes security, nginx, ssl, and sites task files in order

Security hardening: install fail2ban+ufw, deploy jail.local, configure UFW rules (default deny, allow ssh/http/https, enable), deploy sysctl kernel hardening, conditionally harden SSH (disable root login, disable password auth)
Nginx install and configuration: install nginx, deploy nginx.conf and security.conf, create document roots (/opt/server/test|ci|status), deploy static index.html files, enable and start nginx service

SSL certificate generation: install openssl+ca-certificates, create ssl-cert group, create /etc/ssl/certs and /etc/ssl/private dirs, generate self-signed RSA 2048 certs for all 3 sites (idempotent, only if cert/key missing)
Virtual host configuration: deploy site.conf for all 3 sites (test/ci/status.cluster.local) to sites-available, create symlinks in sites-enabled, remove default site symlink

Global Nginx configuration: user www-data, worker_processes auto, worker_connections 768, sendfile/tcp_nopush/tcp_nodelay, keepalive_timeout 65, gzip on, log paths, includes conf.d/*.conf and sites-enabled/*
Fail2Ban jail configuration: DEFAULT (bantime=3600, findtime=600, maxretry=3), sshd, nginx-http-auth, nginx-limit-req (maxretry=10), nginx-botsearch (maxretry=2) jails

Per-site Nginx vhost config: HTTP→HTTPS redirect on port 80, HTTPS on port 443 with ssl http2, TLSv1.2+TLSv1.3, HSTS, security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, X-XSS-Protection, Referrer-Policy, CSP), gzip, try_files, deny .ht*/.git/.svn, per-site access/error logs. Used for all 3 sites via Jinja2 variables.
Nginx security snippet: server_tokens off, rate-limit zones (login/api), client buffer limits, timeouts, SSL session cache, TLSv1.2+TLSv1.3, cipher suite

Kernel sysctl hardening parameters: rp_filter=1, accept_redirects=0 (IPv4+IPv6), send_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0, log_martians=1, icmp_echo_ignore_all=1, icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts=1, disable_ipv6=1, tcp_syncookies=1, tcp_max_syn_backlog=2048, tcp_synack_retries=2, tcp_syn_retries=5
Static HTML landing page for test.cluster.local document root (/opt/server/test/index.html), owner www-data:www-data, mode 0644
Static HTML landing page for ci.cluster.local document root (/opt/server/ci/index.html), owner www-data:www-data, mode 0644
Static HTML landing page for status.cluster.local document root (/opt/server/status/index.html), owner www-data:www-data, mode 0644
Molecule scenario configuration: delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)
Converge playbook: creates expected filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/ — nginx configs, site configs, SSL dirs, document roots, fail2ban jail.local, sysctl conf, sshd_config hardening markers
items.notes: Generated converge.yml recreating full filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/: nginx configs, vhost configs, sites-enabled symlinks, document roots with index.html files, SSL placeholder certs/keys, fail2ban jail.local, sysctl 99-security.conf, and sshd_config with hardening settings.

items.description: No-op instance create playbook (delegated driver)

items.notes: Generated verify.yml split into 7 plays: (1) nginx global configs, (2) vhost configs with content assertions, (3) sites-enabled symlinks + default site removal, (4) document roots and index.html content, (5) SSL cert/key files and permissions, (6) security configs (fail2ban, sysctl, sshd_config), (7) service/port/HTTP checks tagged molecule-notest.
